name: suxi-hotel-naming
description: 为酒店、民宿、门店和房型起名、改名或优化名称；适用于根据定位、真实卖点、房型事实、现有名称、表格或截图生成更清晰的OTA展示名、相似名和层级方案。用户提到门店起名、酒店命名、民宿命名、房型名优化、名字更好卖、类似名称或截图改名时使用。

name: suxi-investment-calculation
description: 用于宿析OS酒店投资测算与收益模型任务，触发场景包括投资测算、回本周期、ROI、IRR、现金流、GOP、RevPAR、ADR、OCC、出租率、房价、成本、租金、装修、加盟费、盈亏平衡、收益预测、投资回报、酒店项目可研、测算表、模型字段和旧数据兼容。

name: suxi-master-advisory
description: 用于用户要求让“165位大师视角”、虚拟顾问团或深度研究参与审查、决策，或与 Codex 一起执行打磨宿析OS功能时，按问题选择2至5个方法视角形成证据会诊，再由 Codex 完成有界实现与验证；普通问答、单一确定性修复或未提及顾问团的常规开发不使用。

name: suxi-ota-exposure-estimation
description: 用于宿析OS按同一门店、同一OTA平台、同一口径的已核验“曝光人数—浏览人数”配对，进行曝光人数派生估算、滚动倍数校准、同日累计重放、估算区间与漂移检查。适用于“曝光反推、曝光漏抓估算、浏览人数倒推曝光人数、曝光→详情浏览一转率校准（detail_visitors / exposure_users）、逐时累计曝光估算”，也负责拒绝跨店套率或把估算回填成OTA事实；不用于采集/查询平台真实曝光、支付转化率或曝光量/曝光次数。

name: suxi-ota-ops
description: 用于宿析OS携程/美团 OTA 数据采集、导入补数与 Profile 登录排障：自动采集、手动导出文件或 Cookie/Payload 补数，以及订单、房价、库存、流量、点评、竞品、排名、转化率、曝光、广告和渠道诊断；也用于 eBooking、Trip Connect、TMC、browser capture、OnlineData、cron_fetch、auto_fetch_online_data。

name: suxi-ota-pms-collector-operating-loop
description: Use for SUXIOS OTA/PMS collection workflow design, login/Profile diagnosis, Ctrip/Meituan/PMS collection boundaries, single-store probes, ETL/write decisions, data-gap reporting, and mapping hotel-auto-x collector skills into the SUXIOS operating loop.

name: suxi-ota-revenue-semantic-layer
description: 用于宿析OS OTA收益分析、定价与投资转让证据边界：选择指标定义、表、来源优先级、粒度、过滤、数据质量，以及定价、运营、投资或转让建议的证据边界和执行闭环；不用于在线采集、报告生成、界面实现或完整 ROI/IRR 现金流测算。

name: suxi-owner-negotiation-qa
description: 用于宿析 OS 业主谈判、酒店托管、收益管理沟通、90 天经营修复计划、业主追问回复、合作成交话术和经营建议表达。触发词包括业主谈判、话术、托管沟通、收益管理方案、止损保本增长、30/60/90 天修复、业主异议、酒店经营回复。

name: suxi-plugin-priority-router
description: 用于宿析OS任务在本地或手工处理前优先路由到已安装 Codex 插件和连接器，触发场景包括插件、连接器、Chrome、GitHub、Computer Use、Figma、Documents、Presentations、Spreadsheets、HyperFrames、Remotion、Canva、Browser、Cloudflare、Data Analytics、Google Drive、OpenAI Developers、Sentry、Skill库改进或插件优先行为。

name: suxi-product-decision
description: 用于宿析OS产品方向、需求优先级、功能取舍、产品分析、产品决策简报、PRD前置判断和“下一步做什么”问题；把已验证业务事实、用户证据、现有能力、风险和未知收敛成一个最高价值决定与最小可验收闭环。普通经营日报、单纯UI实现、范围已明确的bug修复、项目排期或外部发布不使用。

name: suxi-skill-installer
description: 用于宿析OS项目内 Skill 判断、创建、安装与调用，触发场景包括 Skill、插件、自动安装、自动调用、suxi-skill-installer、suxi-os-toolkit、.agents/skills、.agents/plugins、plugins/、curated skill、官方 Skill、联网授权、账号授权、外部权限，或需要决定是否补齐宿析OS专用 Skill。

name: suxi-test-guard
description: 用于宿析OS问题修复和按影响面选择验证，触发场景包括 报错、bug、修复、验证、测试、复现、回归、接口测试、健康检查、curl、Postman、test-api.ps1、test-login.ps1、public/index.html保护、不要构建、Vite覆盖和最小修复。验证用于支持具体判断，不以测试数量、commit/PR 标签或重复全量运行制造信心。

name: suxi-user-research
description: 用于宿析OS用户研究、需求洞察、访谈或问卷方案、可用性测试、真实任务观察、用户反馈综合和改版复验，尤其是验证老板、店长、前台、收益或运营人员能否找到、理解、操作、保存和纠错。没有真实参与者或行为证据时只产出研究计划，不生成虚构发现；普通UI实现、数据分析、功能测试或客服回复不使用。

name: suxi-voice-intent
description: 宿析OS工作区唯一自动语音入口。仅在消息出现明显普通话转录噪声、酒店同音词、口头自我修正、断裂语序、指代不清，或用户明确要求理解语音时使用；语义清楚的消息不加载本 Skill。触发后按字面优先、保守纠正，按需结合酒店热词、用户表达习惯、最近任务和本地 transcript-fixer 语境。保留否定、数字、日期、金额、平台、门店、路径、ID 与写入/发布范围；用户要求逐字保留时不纠正。

name: suxi-yingdao-rpa-reference
description: 用于宿析OS在用户提到影刀、影刀RPA、影刀帮助中心、快速入门、功能/指令/接口/管理/专题文档、常见问题、开放API或解决方案，或明确希望借鉴影刀自动化方法时，检索本地完整公开帮助中心目录并按需读取单条官方文档，将可见方法映射为宿析可验证实现。不要用于普通网页抓取、普通浏览器操作或未指向影刀的自动化任务。

name: suxiaoqiang-cli
description: Use suxiaoqiang-cli (sxq) to sync, edit, preview, release, manage allowlisted project plugins, install private plugin skills, and query Superun Cloud databases or logs from the terminal. Use when the user mentions sxq, suxiaoqiang-cli, a Superun sessionId, project plugin management, db query/logs/migrations, or explicitly requests a maintainer release of the CLI, npm package, plugin skill, or documentation. 当用户提到 sxq、suxiaoqiang-cli、Superun sessionId、项目插件、 私有插件技能、数据库查询/日志/迁移，或明确要求发布 CLI、npm 包、插件 skill 或文档时使用。

name: suy-luan-xac-suat
description: Phương pháp xác suất cho suy luận bất định: Bayes nets và bảng xác suất có điều kiện, posterior inference, decision theory, value of information, Markov decision processes, dynamic decision networks, EM clustering, HMM, Kalman filtering, prediction, smoothing và mechanism design. Chỉ chọn mô hình dựa trên dữ liệu có nguồn và phép đánh giá định lượng.

name: suzhou-trip
description: 好吃好玩在苏州 - 苏州出行与美食规划Agent。优先推荐公交线路（旅游专线、好行观光巴士）， 辅以地铁换乘方案，结合苏州地铁食堂等特色餐饮，为用户规划吃喝玩乐一体化行程。 输出包含可视化HTML行程页面（含高德地图导航链接）。 使用场景：用户说"苏州怎么玩"、"从XX到YY怎么走"、"苏州一日游攻略"、"苏州美食推荐"等。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Agent, WebSearch, WebFetch, AskUserQuestion

name: suzieq-observability
description: SuzieQ network observability — query current and historical network state, run validation assertions, get summary statistics, trace forwarding paths, and discover unique values across 20+ network tables. Use when investigating BGP/OSPF state, checking interface health, performing time-travel queries, validating network assertions, or tracing packet paths through the network via SuzieQ.

name: suzu-paro50
description: Trader agent for Polymarket prediction markets on Polygon with autonomous betting capabilities.

name: suzumi
description: Role-play as 守月スズミ of Blue Archive.

name: suzuri
description: SUZURI（suzuri.jp/ayato_arigato）のグッズを、EC2 のログイン済み Chrome から作る・直す・消す手順。島に新しいキャラクターが入ったときの住人グッズ（カサ・アヤトの住人）と、あやとのステッカーのグッズ化を含む。トリガー語:「SUZURI」「スズリ」「グッズ」「住人グッズ」「カサ・アヤトの住人」「あやとステッカー」「グッズ化」「suzuri」。

name: suzuri-api
description: SUZURI REST APIを使ったアプリケーション構築のガイド。SUZURI APIでグッズを作成・検索・表示するアプリや、SUZURIと連携するサービスを開発する際に使用する。「SUZURIのAPIで」「SUZURIで商品を」「SUZURIと連携」「スズリAPI」「suzuri.jpのAPI」などSUZURIに関連するアプリケーション開発の話題が出たら、このスキルを参照すること。

name: sv
description: This skill should be used when the user invokes `/sv` or asks to "hand this off to sandvault", "continue in the sandbox", "sandvault this task", or to clone the current repo into a sandboxed Claude session with per-repo deploy-key access. Writes a task briefing to the sandvault shared workspace and launches `sv-clone` in a new terminal window, pointing the sandboxed Claude at the briefing as its first prompt.

name: sv-benchmark-against-truth-set
description: Use when a candidate SV call set (from assembly-to-reference callers like SVIM-asm or from minisv on pangenome graphs) must be scored against a truth set for large SVs (>7000 bp or ≥10000 bp) to report precision/recall/F1.

name: sv-benchmark-evaluation-with-truvari
description: Use when query VCFs from SV callers must be assessed against GIAB benchmark SV sets (T2T-HG002-Q100 stvar or CMRG v1.00) to produce per-caller TP/FP/FN, precision, recall, and F1 metrics.

name: sv-benchmarking-with-truvari
description: Use when SV caller VCFs (DEL/INS/INV/TRA/DUP) need quantitative evaluation against a GIAB gold standard, including low-coverage robustness tests and Truvari parameter-sensitivity sweeps.

name: sv-better-keywords
description: Research keywords with volume, CPC, competition and search intent, or AI-filter an existing keyword list, with the SV MCP `better-keywords` tool. Use at the start of a content pipeline, or when the user asks for keyword ideas.

name: sv-breakend-consistency-evaluation
description: Use when validating that locally assembled SV haplotype contigs (e.g. from sawfish discover on HiFi BAMs) reproduce the expected diploid sequence at called breakpoints, independent of variant-based benchmarking.

name: sv-breakpoint-gene-annotation
description: Use when nanopore reads from targeted fusion-gene enrichment need fusion partner and breakpoint identification, i.e. mapping long reads to GRCh37, calling SVs, and annotating SV breakpoints with genes to nominate fusions.

name: sv-breakpoint-read-haplotype-assignment
description: Use when long nanopore reads overlapping trio-phased heterozygous SNPs must be assigned to a parental haplotype — e.g. to determine the parental origin of de novo SV breakpoint junctions or to phase NanoSV/Manta SV calls against a trio-phased SNP ground truth.

name: sv-build-environment
description: Build the dynamic environment E for a SocioVerse2 study — the two-axis layers (physical/information × macro/local), scheduled interventions, and audience-scoped information broadcasts. Use after sv-init, before sv-build-population. This is the "information retriever / environment builder" stage.

name: sv-build-model
description: Implement a NEW from-scratch SocioVerse2 study's functional code on the Core kernel — the four abc implementations (EnvironmentProvider, PopulationProvider, DecisionModel, MetricCollector) written natively, no legacy wrap, no engine-seam. Use only on Path B (sv-init found no matching existing study). Skip for Path A (reuse) and for collaborators wrapping a legacy simulator (that is the CLAUDE-dev.md adapter path).

name: sv-build-population
description: Build the fixed population pool P for a SocioVerse2 study — personas with persistent ids, interaction structure, and propagation mode. Use after sv-build-environment, before sv-run. Supports census, MCP population pools (single or composed across several), and user-uploaded sources.

name: sv-call-accuracy-evaluation-against-truth-set
description: Use when you need to quantify how accurately different long-read mappers detect implanted or known inversions by calling SVs from each mapper's alignments and comparing them to a truth VCF.

name: sv-call-benchmarking-against-nist-truth-set
description: Use when evaluating deletion SV calling performance on third-generation sequencing data with a known truth set, or when reproducing precision/recall/F1 comparisons across multiple callers on HG002 GIAB samples.

name: sv-call-count-reproduction
description: Use when validating a somatic SV caller against published cell-line benchmarks (COLO829, H2009, HCC1954 tumor/control ONT pairs) and you need exact PASS call counts comparable to a reported result.

name: sv-call-filtering-by-caller-support
description: Use when you have raw SV calls from ≥2 independent callers (e.g. VCFs from Delly, Lumpy, Pindel) on the same aligned BAMs and need a high-specificity consensus call set by requiring multi-caller support.

name: sv-call-pre-filtering
description: Use when building per-caller SV candidate VCFs from ONT fastq.gz reads (e.g. HG00733, HG00514, NA19240) and preparing them for downstream consensus in ConsensuSV-ONT.

name: sv-call-set-intersection-against-validated-junctions
description: Use when finished SV call sets (VCF) from multiple callers must be scored for recall against curated breakpoint-junction truth sets, e.g. validated de novo chromothripsis junctions per patient.

name: sv-call-vs-truth-matching
description: Use when you have SAM/BAM alignments from multiple long-read mappers over a simulated benchmark with a known ground-truth SV set, and need to rank mapper-caller combinations by inversion detection sensitivity and precision.

name: sv-caller-accuracy-ranking-comparison
description: Use when comparing accuracy of long-read SV callers against a GIAB truth set and you need F1 rankings stratified by SV length (50-499 bp, 500-4999 bp, >=5000 bp).

name: sv-caller-benchmark-f1-computation
description: Use when comparing SV caller accuracy from Truvari GA4GH VCF outputs and you need per-size-stratum (50-499 bp, 500-4999 bp, >=5000 bp) precision/recall/F1 rankings across callers.

name: sv-caller-precision-recall-evaluation
description: Use when comparing insertion-calling tools on simulated linked-read data with a known ground truth, or when reproducing the reported precision/recall values for Novel-X versus NUI, PopIns2 and Pamir at 65x coverage.

name: sv-caller-vcf-conversion-and-normalization
description: Use when raw SV calls from independent tools (e.g. DELLY, Lumpy, Pindel) are in heterogeneous formats and must be unified as VCF records with consistent coordinates and SV type annotations before consensus merging.

name: sv-callset-benchmarking
description: Use when evaluating or reproducing SV caller performance metrics (precision/recall/F1) on simulated or GIAB/Wagner-style truth sets using synthetic long reads, hybrid SLR+long-read data, or low-coverage (e.g. 5x) long-read benchmarks.

name: sv-callset-f1-comparison-across-callers
description: Use when comparing germline SV calling accuracy of multiple long-read callers on HG002 HiFi WGS data against the GIAB draft T2T SV benchmark (GRCh38_HG2-T2TQ100-V1.1_stvar) or the GIAB CMRG SV benchmark, to obtain size-stratified F1-scores and caller rankings.

name: sv-callset-intersection-with-truth-panels
description: Use when a filtered SV VCF or BED callset from long-read (MinION/nanopore) calling must be quantified for recall and precision against an established reference SV panel on a defined region such as NA12878 chromosome 1.

name: sv-cnv-calling
description: Use when detecting, merging, filtering, or benchmarking structural variants or copy-number changes from short-read, exome, or long-read data. Not for repeats (repeat-expansions) or paralogs (difficult-genes-and-mito).

name: sv-composition
description: 结合 AKDAgent 本地工具进行旋律、和声、编曲结构和乐句设计，或分析已有音乐段落。仅在用户要求作曲编曲时扩展素材，不把人声调教变成重写歌曲。

name: sv-content-quality
description: Score a live page's content quality for a target keyword (E-E-A-T and helpful-content criteria) with the SV MCP `content-quality` tool, optionally comparing two URLs. Use after drafting and publishing, or to evaluate an existing page.

name: sv-content-transformer
description: Rewrite or reformat text the user already has into a chosen content type (meta title, product description, landing-page copy and more) with the SV MCP `content-transformer` tool. Use to reshape existing copy. To write new content use sv-seogpt or sv-prose.

name: sv-core-analysis
description: Run an element-by-element on-page SEO analysis of a URL (status, load speed, title, meta description, headings, keyword usage) and compare it with the top-ranked pages, using the SV MCP `core-analysis` tool. Use to benchmark a page against competitors.

name: sv-dev
description: Development workflow for Security Verifiers. Use when asked to run tests, lint code, format files, set up the development environment, or perform CI checks on the codebase.

name: sv-diff
description: Compare two SystemVerilog/Verilog sources with `verible-verilog-diff` for a semantic, SV-aware diff that ignores whitespace and comment-only changes. Use when the user wants to compare two `.sv` files, or two git revisions of the same file, and plain `diff` would be noisy because of formatting or comments.

name: sv-experiment
description: Entry point for experiments whose printed numbers must be traceable: freezing corpus, samples, gold sets and model or prompt versions, the runs log, numbers checked into the paper, and the replication artifact. Routes to one sv-experiment sub-command and says which. Use when setting up, running, reporting or packaging experiments.

name: sv-experiment-freeze
description: Freezes what an experiment depends on before any model output is seen: the corpus, the sample and gold set, model and prompt versions with a pre-set acceptance bar, and the rule that disagreements become written rules rather than silent fixes. Use when setting up an experiment, building a gold set or annotation round, or changing a prompt or model.

name: sv-experiment-numbers
description: Moves numbers from runs into the paper so each one is traceable: a numbers file generated by scripts, macros or tables built from it, a check that every number in the manuscript matches the file, and verified numbers recorded in STATUS before they reach the text. Use when numbers enter or change in the paper, or before submission.

name: sv-experiment-prereg
description: Locks a confirmatory analysis before outcomes are seen: hypotheses, the estimand, the exact primary analysis, the decision rule, stopping and multiplicity are written down and frozen as a git commit, and an audit later proves the registration preceded every committed output and was never edited. Anything not registered is reported as exploratory. Use when a hypothesis test, an effect estimate or a p-value will support a claim, before the outcome data is looked at.

name: sv-experiment-replication
description: Prepares where data lives and the replication artifact: data placement and compute backend, a manifest of data files that can be rebuilt and verified, an anonymized artifact checked for identity leaks, and the mirror for double-blind review. Use when deciding data storage, packaging a replication artifact, or checking an anonymous mirror.

name: sv-experiment-runs
description: Keeps the runs log and the state files of a project's experiments: a row per run when it starts with command, code commit, data version, backend, status and outputs, failed runs recorded and never deleted, outputs never overwritten, and diffable state files as the authority over web dashboards. Use when logging runs, reviewing what ran, or deciding where label and queue state lives.

name: sv-feature-extraction
description: Use when you have a NanoSV VCF of SV calls from long nanopore reads and need per-call numeric features to train or apply a machine-learning filter (e.g. random forest in scikit-learn) that separates true SVs from false positives beyond baseline precision (~54%).

name: sv-feature-vector-computation
description: Use when you have putative SV calls (VCF/BED from dysgu or gold sets such as GIAB HG001/HG002 or pbsv PacBio calls) and need feature vectors plus quality probabilities for ML-based SV classification.

name: sv-feedback
description: Entry point for handling feedback: turns comments from advisors, co-authors, reviewers or agents into tracked revisions with IDs, one change per comment and diff verification; records expert guidance with actions and follow-up; and plans peer-review rebuttals by reviewer mindset and strategy. Routes each request to one sv-feedback sub-command and says which. Use when feedback, advice or reviews arrive.

name: sv-feedback-guidance
description: Records expert guidance on a paper or experiment as a dated guidance record: the scenario shown, verbatim quotes, the interpretation marked as such, points to notice, actions with owners, due dates and done criteria, and the decision; later lists open, overdue and unevidenced actions. Use when advice arrives from a meeting, call or relayed message, or to check which advice was followed up.

name: sv-feedback-rebuttal
description: Provides actionable peer-review rebuttal guidance, not finished rebuttal prose: inventories and classifies concerns, matches the reviewer mindset and strategy on ML venues, gives per-concern plans with evidence pointers, and picks a conference, journal or internal response format. Use when the user pastes reviewer comments, asks how to respond to a reviewer, needs a journal revision letter plan, or says the reviewer ignored the rebuttal.

name: sv-feedback-revise
description: Turns comments on a manuscript into tracked revisions: collects every comment from every channel, gives it an ID, triages it, applies one change per comment with the ID in the commit, keeps note markers until their owner closes them, verifies each claimed change against the actual diff, and fills the response table. Use when inline TeX notes, PDF annotations, chat requests or review reports arrive.

name: sv-figure
description: Entry point for every figure task: design advice for a paper's core figures, draw.io reconstruction of a reference image, plots from code, TikZ, HTML or SVG figures, posters, and explanatory figures for learning. Routes to one sv-figure sub-command and says which. Use when the user asks to design, draw, plot or rebuild anything visual.

name: sv-figure-design
description: Advises on the design of a technical paper's three core figures: the motivated example (Figure 1), the solution overview, and the experimental results. Identifies the figure type, recommends a paradigm, sketches the layout, guides labels and annotations, suggests a tool, and audits the universal and archive figure rules with severity. Use when the user asks to design, critique or improve a paper figure.

name: sv-figure-drawio
description: Reconstructs reference images into high-fidelity, editable Draw.io files with rendered previews: native Draw.io elements carry text and structure, SVG covers simple icons that match the reference, and cropped or transparent PNGs preserve complex visuals. Use when the user wants a diagram image, research figure, architecture diagram, slide, UI screenshot, or image folder turned into `.drawio` XML; batch requests use a manifest with bounded parallelism when available and a full-fidelity serial fallback otherwise.

name: sv-figure-explain
description: Draws explanatory figures for learning: scene cards, four-panel comics, textbook and auto-laid-out DAGs, mind maps, explainer pages and steppers for proofs, algorithms and numeric processes, built from the vendored offline kit as HTML with SVG and KaTeX, rendered to PNG and inspected. Never invents numbers. Use when a concept, paper or chapter needs a picture in study notes, or the study skill asks for one.

name: sv-figure-html
description: Produces SVG or HTML figures with the vendored offline kit: copy a template, edit its data block, render to PNG in headless Chrome, inspect, and save the HTML and PNG together. Covers explainer pages, steppers, DAGs and mind maps for papers, slides or the web, and figures in a Claude Design style. Use when the user wants an SVG, HTML or interactive figure rather than a plot or TikZ.

name: sv-figure-plot
description: Produces data and mathematical figures from code, saving the figure and the script together: Matplotlib or Seaborn in a reusable plotting script, Plotly for interactive views, vector output sized to the column, and numbers that trace to the project's numbers file. Applies the results figure guidance and universal rules. Use when the user wants a plot, chart or mathematical figure generated from data or a formula.

name: sv-figure-poster
description: Plans and checks a research poster with the library's figure rules: one message per panel, figures reused from the paper under the universal design rules, a tool chosen from the tool matrix, and the archive figure rules audit. States plainly that no poster-specific rules exist yet. Use when the user asks to make, lay out or review a conference or group poster.

name: sv-figure-tikz
description: Builds TikZ and PGFPlots figures for LaTeX papers and decks in a render-and-inspect loop: a standalone render to PDF and PNG, inspection of the PNG for overlaps, clipping and legibility, a short review note, and done only when the inspection is recorded. Follows the universal figure rules. Use when the user wants a TikZ or PGFPlots figure written, fixed, or reviewed.

name: sv-format
description: Format a SystemVerilog/Verilog file with `verible-verilog-format`, either in-place (rewrite the file) or in preview mode (print formatted text to stdout, file unchanged). Use when the user asks to "format this `.sv` file", "reformat X", or "show me what Y would look like formatted / preview the formatting before I commit".

name: sv-genotype-phenotype-mapping
description: Use when a genotype matrix of SVs (duplications, deletions, translocations) and a table of quantitative trait measurements across a strain panel are both available and the goal is to map SVs to trait variation.

name: sv-genotype-table-parsing
description: Use when a published SV study deposits a curated callset (e.g. on Figshare) and you must reproduce its reported catalogue size and per-class composition from the deposited SV records, genotypes and copy numbers.

name: sv-geo-audit
description: Run a GEO audit with the SV MCP `geogptaudit` tool (async): how a domain or page is visible in AI-generated answers for specific entities, with citation targets, schema fixes, quick wins and a roadmap. Use when the user asks for a GEO audit or AI-visibility score for named entities.

name: sv-gtm
description: Marketing and commercial GTM operating system for market opportunity, consumer insight and psychology, brand positioning, product definition, content strategy, growth marketing, business-case modeling, pricing, “五点三包”, evidence-based decisions, multi-agent routing, and post-launch review. Use when the user asks for新品上市、品类战略、市场调研、消费者心理、购买动机、品牌定位、内容策略、增长营销、媒介投放、产品定义、销量预测、盈利测算、GTM方案、五点三包、定价调价、渠道策略、商业化决策、GTM智能体或多Agent workflow。

name: sv-gtm-business-case
description: 为产品、SKU、渠道、新品上市或业务单元建立、审计和诊断经营财务模型。适用于销量预测、价格收入桥、成交总额/销售总额/收入、管理损益、单台经济、渠道利润、获客成本、最高物料成本、价格底线、回本、库存资金、敏感性、预算差异及经营决策。

name: sv-haplotype-contig-alignment
description: Use when an assembly/locus-based SV caller (e.g. sawfish discover) emits per-breakpoint SV haplotype consensus contigs and you need orthogonal, sequence-level evidence that the calls are real and correctly placed.

name: sv-haplotype-local-assembly-and-poa-consensus
description: Use when calling germline SVs from mapped HiFi reads where breakpoint evidence must be resolved to basepair resolution via local haplotype assembly rather than read-pair heuristics.

name: sv-idea
description: Entry point for judging a research idea: a full evaluation with first impression, fatal-flaws gate, lifecycle and capability matching, five-dimension scoring, paradigm-shift probe, feasibility and a verdict, or only the fatal-flaws gate when time is short. Routes to one sv-idea sub-command and says which. Use when the user asks whether an idea is worth pursuing, novel enough, or fatally flawed.

name: sv-idea-evaluate
description: Evaluates a preliminary research idea in full: first impression and paper type, the fatal-flaws gate, empirical-study and theory routes, lifecycle and student-capability matching, five-dimension scoring (higher, faster, stronger, cheaper, broader), a paradigm-shift probe, feasibility, the integrity gate and a verdict. Use when the user wants a complete judgment of an idea before investing in it.

name: sv-idea-fatal-flaws
description: Runs only the early gate of the idea evaluation: the audit against the ten canonical fatal flaws (no novelty against the closest work, wrong venue, wrong baseline, weak motivation, capability mismatch, unverifiable claim, ethical or data blocker, scope, solution hunting, no failure case), at most two flaws reported with detection rule and defense. Use when the user wants a quick check before a full evaluation.

name: sv-init
description: Entry point for a NEW SocioVerse2 study from a user's research query. Use at the START of a simulation study — it FIRST routes the query against already-adapted studies (catalog of studies/*/study.yaml) to choose reuse/adjust (Path A) vs build-new, and only then parses the query into a validated StudySpec + ResourceManifest and scaffolds the standardized layout the other sv-* skills consume. NOT for changing a study that already exists — modify/extend/iterate requests on an existing study (especially one just run) route to /sv-iterate instead.

name: sv-insight-igniter
description: Show which entities and topics AI engines associate with a website, given only its URL, using the SV MCP `insight-igniter` tool (fast, synchronous). Use for open-ended questions like what AI associates with a site. For specific entities use sv-geo-audit.

name: sv-iterate
description: The ONLY entry point for changing an EXISTING SocioVerse2 study — especially one that already ran. Use whenever the user asks to modify, extend, adjust, tune, or iterate a study, add another round/step, add or change a policy/broadcast/intervention, change parameters (n_steps, seed, scale), swap population or decision logic, or open a counterfactual branch that keeps an earlier run's history. It runs the mandatory version gate (new version vs counterfactual branch vs modify-in-place — always asked, never assumed), then re-enters the standard sv-* pipeline at the earliest affected stage. NEVER…

name: sv-lint
description: Run Verible's lint over SystemVerilog/Verilog files and surface diagnostics. Use when the user wants lint output for one or more `.sv`/`.svh`/`.v`/`.vh` files (e.g. "lint this file", "what does Verible say about X", "check this RTL for warnings").

name: sv-lit
description: Survey real related work for a SocioVerse2 study. Two tiers — a fast default across OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar / CrossRef / PubMed / arXiv (+ Chinese-native sources) via the vendored paper-search-pro engine, and an opt-in deep tier (deep-research lit-review) that adds multi-agent synthesis and per-reference verification but is markedly slower and more expensive, so ask first. Either way, write per-paper relevance notes tied to THIS study and produce literature/literature.json + references.bib for the dashboard's Literature tab and /sv-paper's Related Work. Usable any time after sv-init; /sv-…

name: sv-litreview
description: Entry point for literature work: a survey-grade investigation with frozen questions, adversarial search, verified citations and a calibrated synthesis, or a literature map built from the cards and notes already read. Routes to one sv-litreview sub-command and says which. Use when the user needs a survey, related work, or a map of their reading.

name: sv-litreview-map
description: Builds a literature map from what the user has read: quickread cards and study notes found through the reading root's index, an evolution map of read and cited-only papers with typed edges, a comparison table with sources, an evidence-backed gap list, and next reads by backward and forward citation chaining. Use when the user wants to map papers already read, find gaps, or plan next reads.

name: sv-litreview-survey
description: Runs a survey-grade literature investigation: checks search capability, freezes the research brief, scouts from several adversarial perspectives, verifies every citation, synthesizes evidence into a MECE taxonomy with in-sentence citations and calibrated hedges, and passes six quality gates before delivery. Use when the user needs a literature survey or an evidence review on a research question.

name: sv-live
description: 通过 AKDAgent Plugin 检查或实时编辑打开的 Synthesizer V 工程、音符、轨道和参数，或排查桥接连接。用于用户提出 SV 内操作时，不用于插件安装或普通 MCP 概念解释。

name: sv-lyrics
description: 为 Synthesizer V 填入已有歌词、创作歌词、核对中文倒字和咬字，并处理延音对位。已有歌词回填不等于授权重新作词或改变音符结构。

name: sv-marketplace-services
description: Search SV's catalog of purchasable done-for-you services (SEO, PPC, development) by search term with price, series and category filters, using the SV MCP `marketplace-services` tool. Use only when the user asks to find SV services.

name: sv-navigate
description: Navigate Verilog/SystemVerilog code through the odve-index MCP (ctags + slang over the real filelists) instead of reading files - where a symbol is defined, who references it, what a file declares, the elaborated DUT instance tree, the UVM component tree, what a filelist compiles. Use it BEFORE opening any .sv/.svh file to answer "where is X", "who uses X", "what is in this file", "how is the testbench built", "which list compiles this", and after creating or editing .sv/.svh/.f files to keep the index current (index_update). Applies in this repo and in every repo that carries odve as a submo…

name: sv-number
description: Order a private phone number in any country over the API, receive the SMS verification code, and hand the number back. Use when an agent has to pass a phone check during signup, login or account recovery, or needs a TOTP second factor computed locally.

name: sv-paper
description: Draft the full academic paper for a SocioVerse2 study — abstract/intro/related work/methods/results/discussion — from the study's own artifacts (report, DuckDB trajectory, grounding, literature). Writes paper/paper.md for the dashboard's Paper tab. Use after sv-report. REQUIRES a literature survey: if literature/literature.json is missing, run /sv-lit first and finish it before drafting.

name: sv-post-calling-filtering
description: Use when you have a raw NanoSV (or equivalent long-read) SV VCF and need to remove likely false positives, especially calls anchored in homopolymer or tandem-repeat regions and small indels below the 40 bp SV threshold.

name: sv-precision-recall-benchmarking
description: Use when comparing SV-caller outputs (VCFs from dysgu, manta, delly, lumpy, strelka, gatk) against a reference call set (e.g. NIST_SVs_Integration_v0.6) to quantify per-class precision/recall/F1.

name: sv-preliminary-audit
description: Run a quick technical SEO health check on a URL (canonical tags, blocking meta tags, load speed, SSL, robots, sitemap) and get an overall score with the SV MCP `preliminaryaudit` tool. Use as a fast first-pass diagnostic. For an element-by-element review use sv-core-analysis.

name: sv-project
description: 检查、复制、迁移或编辑 SVP 工程文件，包括 SV1/SV2 差异及其他歌声工程转换。保留源文件，区分磁盘编辑与 SV 内实时编辑。

name: sv-proposal
description: Entry point for research proposals: thesis proposals (kaiti reports), grant applications such as NSFC, NSF, ERC and NIH, and research statements or PhD plans, built from a spine, evidence ledger, timeline and risks before drafting. Routes to one sv-proposal sub-command and says which. Use when the user needs a proposal, grant or research statement.

name: sv-proposal-grant
description: Plans and drafts a grant application for NSFC, NSF, ERC or NIH: the call sheet with verified limits, the proposal spine of questions, aims and feasibility, an evidence ledger, section map, timeline and risks, a draft in the funder's register, and a reviewer pass against the funder's criteria. Use when the user needs a grant application or a specific aims page.

name: sv-proposal-kaiti
description: Plans and drafts a thesis proposal (kaiti report): the call sheet from the department's rules, the proposal spine of questions, aims and feasibility, an evidence ledger, section map, timeline and risks, a draft in the Chinese kaiti register with visible gap markers, and a reviewer pass. Use when the user needs a thesis proposal or opening report.

name: sv-proposal-statement
description: Plans and drafts a research statement or a PhD research proposal: the spine of questions, aims and feasibility, an evidence ledger, section map and timeline, a draft in proposal register, and a reviewer pass. Use when the user needs a research statement for the job market or a fellowship, or a research plan for a PhD application.

name: sv-prose
description: Write a full long-form SEO or GEO article, blog post, guide or landing page with the SV MCP `prose` tool (async). Use when the user wants a complete article on a topic. For short snippets such as meta titles use sv-seogpt.

name: sv-quickread
description: Entry point for quick reads of one paper: a one-page, five-minute card in nine fixed sections with sourced results, graded contributions and a claim-evidence table, optionally with a Style Card of its writing. Routes to one sv-quickread sub-command and says which. Use when the user hands over one paper and wants its gist quickly.

name: sv-quickread-card
description: Writes the nine-section quick-read card for one paper: problem, core idea, a field-specific method block, results copied with locations, contributions tagged proved, empirical or conjectured, a claim-evidence table, limitations, and the link to the reader's research. Text through MinerU only; checked and indexed. Use when the user wants one paper summarized quickly or triaged.

name: sv-quickread-style
description: Writes the quick-read card and also dissects the paper's writing into one Paper Style Card (structure, rhetorical moves, sentence templates) in the sv-write-style-mine format, saved beside the card as a candidate for a venue profile. One card never becomes a rule. Use when the user wants a paper read quickly and its writing style analysed for a target venue.

name: sv-ranklens
description: Measure how a website ranks for an entity or keyword across repeated AI-engine queries, and find the competitors that appear, with the SV MCP `ranklens` tool. Use for brand-level AI visibility and competitor benchmarking.

name: sv-raw-review
description: Rules for reading SystemVerilog source directly when the odve-index MCP cannot answer (a tool returned error, the file is in no elaborated unit, the index is unavailable) or when a review genuinely needs the code - how to read as little as possible, by outline and ranges, following filelists not directories, never the UVM library. Use it whenever you are about to Read or cat a .sv/.svh file, grep across odve/, or review generated agent code line by line.

name: sv-recall-fpr-evaluation
description: Use when comparing SV caller sensitivity/FPR (e.g., NanoSV vs Lumpy vs Sniffles) from simulated nanopore reads with a known set of rearrangement breakpoints as ground truth.

name: sv-report
description: Render the displayable time-step change for a SocioVerse2 study — per-step maps, a metric timeline (with intervention markers), and report.md, all queried from the DuckDB trajectory store. Use after sv-run.

name: sv-review
description: Entry point for reviewing a manuscript before it leaves the group: a read- only pre-submission audit with sub-checklists and a submission-day runbook, or a bounded multi-round check of research fit, venue style and language with a round log. Routes to one sv-review sub-command and says which. Use when the user asks to review, audit, proofread or re-check a draft.

name: sv-review-loop
description: Runs a bounded multi-round check over a manuscript: research-writing fit first (claims, scope, hedges, numbers, threats), then venue and field style, then language through a de-AI audit, with a regression re-run of the research check. Applies only authorized edits, guards spans against reversion and locked-decision flips, and writes a dated round log. Use when a draft needs repeated checking before review, submission or camera-ready.

name: sv-review-once
description: Runs a read-only pre-submission review of a technical paper across five dimensions (macro logic, writing details, English grammar, LaTeX formatting, figure quality) with CRITICAL, MAJOR and MINOR findings, then the research-core threats, double-blind, artifact, venue-submission and integrity checklists, a devil's-advocate pass, and the submission-day runbook. Use when the user asks to review, audit or proofread a paper before a deadline.

name: sv-run
description: Execute the longitudinal simulation run for a SocioVerse2 study — bind P + E + decision model + schedule, run the E_t→B_t→E_{t+1} loop, and persist the panel + metrics to DuckDB. Use after the environment and population bundles exist.

name: sv-score-normalization-across-classifiers
description: Use when comparing SV pathogenicity predictions from tools that output scores on different scales, especially when ranking the disease-causative gene for positive-control SVs against a patient-cohort background.

name: sv-seo-mapping
description: Map a list of keywords to the most relevant existing pages on a domain, and detect keyword cannibalization, with the SV MCP `seogptmapping` tool (async). Use for site-wide structure, internal linking and content-gap planning.

name: sv-seogpt
description: Generate short-form SEO or GEO copy (meta titles, meta descriptions, FAQs, social posts, ad copy) with the SV MCP `seogpt` tool. Use when the user wants one specific short piece of content from a keyword. For full articles use sv-prose.

name: sv-seogpt-compare
description: Get competitive SEO strategy for one URL and one target keyword with the SV MCP `seogptcompare` tool (async), which compares the page against its top competitors. Use when the question is strategic, such as what to prioritize for this page and keyword.

name: sv-signature-threshold-filtering
description: Use when mining a contig-to-reference BAM (primary + supplementary split blocks) for large INS/DEL signatures with the 30 bp Diff_dis / 3000 bp Diff_olp thresholds of the VolcanoSV-vc large indel module.

name: sv-size-and-class-distribution-analysis
description: Use when you have long-read (e.g., nanopore NanoSV VCF) SV call sets plus matched short-read caller outputs and need to classify which calls are novel, then profile their size bins, GC content, and retrotransposon (LINE) enrichment.

name: sv-slides
description: Entry point for LaTeX Beamer decks for math and statistics group meetings: a weekly report that carries last week's next steps forward, or a critical paper talk with estimand, identification and reproducibility slides, compiled, linted and rendered. Routes to one sv-slides sub-command and says which. Use when the user needs group-meeting slides.

name: sv-slides-talk
description: Builds a 12 to 18 slide critical paper talk in Beamer: the paper's section tree mapped to slide groups, plus the critical slides (paper card with estimand and identification, ranked assumptions, results with sources and no causal verbs, claims against evidence, link to the project, reproducibility, a discussion question). Use when the user presents a paper at a group meeting or journal club.

name: sv-slides-weekly
description: Builds the weekly-report Beamer deck: conclusions first, last week's next steps marked done, partial or dropped, results with sources, blockers, decisions needed, and next steps with owner, date and kill criterion; the progress variant groups the same spine by topic. Compiles, lints, renders and exports notes. Use when the user needs this week's group-meeting slides.

name: sv-study
description: Entry point for understanding-first study: explains a concept, works through a paper or textbook chapter one idea at a time with the learner's restatement and diagnosis, draws explanatory figures, runs optional drills, and bridges learning to the project. Routes to one sv-study sub- command and says which. Use when the user wants to really understand something.

name: sv-study-bridge
description: Bridges something just read or learned to the current research project: maps the source setting onto the project, checks which assumptions transfer, gives one of five verdicts on whether and how to use it, and designs the cheapest validation experiment with expected results and a kill criterion fixed in advance. Use when the user asks whether a method just read or studied fits the project.

name: sv-study-chapter
description: Works through a textbook chapter or lecture notes understanding-first: maps the chapter's concepts and their order, checks prerequisites against the learner profile with one short question each, runs the protocol per concept with restatement and diagnosis, and keeps book progress in the study vault. Use when the user wants to study chapter N of a book or a set of lecture notes.

name: sv-study-drill
description: Switches on one of the study drill options that are off by default: Socratic dialogue, Feynman explain-back, light self-test with confidence ratings, proof reconstruction with gaps for the learner, notes only, or Anki export of approved concept notes. High-confidence wrong answers go to the misconceptions file. Use when the user asks to be quizzed, tested, questioned Socratically, or to export cards.

name: sv-study-paper
description: Works through one paper understanding-first: official PDF first through MinerU, the concepts the paper needs planned in dependency order, the protocol run per concept with restatement and diagnosis, formulas and numbers copied with locations, and the session saved to the paper folder and the study vault. Use when the user wants a close reading of a paper rather than a quick card.

name: sv-study-quick-explain
description: Explains one concept understanding-first with no source material: plain principle, motivation, a minimal example, links to what the learner already knows, one or two pictures, then the learner's restatement, diagnosis against the expert mental model and correction. Uses the study vault's profile when it exists. Use when the user asks to understand or explain a single concept.

name: sv-study-visual-explain
description: Draws the motivation or structure figure for the concept being studied, as the study protocol's picture step: picks a kit template, fills it from the session's content without inventing numbers, renders and inspects it, and saves the HTML and PNG next to the notes. A thin entry to the figure group's explain sub-command. Use when a study session needs a picture.

name: sv-supervisor
description: Entry point for running a research project: a start-up interview that writes research.yaml and docs, a session brief with stage, deadline, blockers and next skills, project records (STATUS, TODO, decisions, logs), and lessons harvested into research-core. Routes to one sv-supervisor sub- command and says which. Use when starting a session or project, or updating records.

name: sv-supervisor-brief
description: Gives a read-only session brief for a research project: the stage in research.yaml and the stage the repository signals suggest, the next deadline with its source, blockers, overdue guidance, open reviewer markers and records warnings, then routes to one to three skills with a reason each. Routes reading and learning requests by intent. Never does the work. Use when starting a session or asking what to do next.

name: sv-supervisor-harvest
description: Turns a project's feedback tables, guidance records, decision records, review-loop logs, STATUS and git history, plus expert notes, into sourced and deduplicated rule candidates for research-core, classifies where each belongs, and proposes the change on a learn branch for the owner to approve. Also starts a new field profile. Use when a milestone is reached, after a submission, or when a new field needs a profile.

name: sv-supervisor-init
description: Starts a research project: interviews the user one short block at a time (field, paper type, stage, venue and deadline with its official source, repositories and the one writable source of truth, data and compute, records and co-author note macros), writes research.yaml after showing the diff, and sets up docs with STATUS, TODO, ADR 0001 and logs. Use when a project or repository has no research.yaml yet.

name: sv-supervisor-records
description: Keeps a research project's records outside the paper: STATUS with the current state only, TODO, numbered decision records, dated logs and group-meeting logs, sources of truth for paper, data and numbers with a sync guard, the notes lifecycle, de-accretion of docs, and an optional Linear mirror. Use when updating status, recording a decision, naming a source of truth, syncing a co-edited paper, or cleaning up project docs.

name: sv-top-competitors
description: List the top-ranking competitor URLs for a keyword with the SV MCP `top-competitors` tool. Use early in a competitive analysis to decide who to benchmark against. For a full comparison of one URL against its competitors use sv-seogpt-compare.

name: sv-topical-authority
description: Build a topical content plan for a keyword (suggested article topics, plus related subtopics in SEO mode) with the SV MCP `topical-authority` tool. Use for content strategy and planning once keyword research is done. To write the articles use sv-prose.

name: sv-trend-diagnostic
description: Invoke when EVM Schedule Variance (SV) is negative, flat, or worsening across reporting periods and is treated as a status number instead of a corrective trigger, or when a PM must diagnose why a program isn't recovering despite visible schedule pressure.

name: sv-trusteval-c-eval
description: Evaluates LLMs' structural and semantic reasoning capabilities in C code vulnerability analysis. It probes whether models rely on memorized patterns or genuinely understand code interdependencies by testing consistency across base, data-flow, control-flow, counterfactual, goal-driven, and predictive scenarios. Use when the user wants to benchmark on SV-TrustEval-C, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Cons_DFL.

name: sv-truth-set-comparison
description: Use when you have simulated reads with a known embedded SV set (e.g. 900 SVs from SURVIVOR simulateSV) and need to score mapper/tool SV calls (recall, precision, F1) against the truth set.

name: sv-variant-overlap-collapse
description: Use when a sample has multiple SV caller VCFs (e.g. the six callers of ConsensuSV-ONT) that must be merged and deduplicated into one overlapping-variant-free candidate VCF before consensus scoring or CNN filtering.

name: sv-vocal-tuning
description: 在 Synthesizer V 中按乐句、歌词和演唱风格调教人声音高、咬字、颤音、呼吸及表现参数。适用于人声调教与机械感诊断，不用于音高曲线画图彩蛋。

name: sv-write
description: Entry point for research writing: paper skeletons, Introductions and other sections, polishing and Chinese-to-English rewriting, critique without edits, de-AI editing of papers, reports, slides and letters, and mining or applying venue style. Routes to one sv-write sub-command and says which. Use when the user asks to write, revise, polish, de-AI or style research text.

name: sv-write-critique
description: Critiques a draft without editing it: runs the source-recall and verification checklist, the reader-logic checks, the logic-chain consistency checks when a skeleton exists, and the research-core writing checklist, then says whether each problem is language, structure, or a claim the evidence may not carry. Returns findings only. Use when the user asks what is wrong with a draft, wants a critique, or says not to edit.

name: sv-write-humanize-audit
description: Runs the report-only de-AI audit: S1 to S7 scores, the five tests (topic-sentence, movability, asymmetry, falsifier, deletion), a gate verdict, and a finding list where every finding carries an edit class for sv-review-loop. Never edits. Use when the user wants a de-AI gate before review or submission, or when sv-review-loop runs its language round.

name: sv-write-humanize-letter
description: Removes machine-written texture from letters and applications: response letters, rebuttals and emails to advisors use the academic-response profile (version narration expected, one polite opener allowed); proposals and grant applications use the academic profile. Same protected-content contract as the paper sub-command. Use when a rebuttal, response letter, email, proposal or grant text reads as AI-generated.

name: sv-write-humanize-paper
description: Removes machine-written texture from a paper, thesis chapter or section under the academic profile: diagnoses restatement, defensiveness, false symmetry and reporting hygiene as S1 to S7 against a claim ledger, then edits only under the contract that protects numbers, citations, terms and LaTeX. Use when a manuscript reads as AI-generated and the user wants it diagnosed or rewritten, or its numbers cleaned up.

name: sv-write-humanize-report
description: Removes machine-written texture from reports: weekly and progress reports, STATUS and other files under docs/ use the docs profile (clarity over voice); technical reports for outside readers use the academic profile. Same diagnosis and editing contract as the paper sub-command, so numbers, citations and terms stay protected. Use when a report, status update or project document reads as AI-generated.

name: sv-write-humanize-slides
description: Removes machine-written texture from slide decks: frame titles and bodies use the slides profile (one hedge per claim, a selling point stated once per deck, no slogan closers, title verbs at or below the evidence level), while Beamer note text uses the academic profile. Use when a Beamer or other deck reads as AI-generated, or when the group-meeting deck skill calls for its de-AI audit.

name: sv-write-intro
description: Drafts the Introduction as flowing prose. Technique and new-problem papers follow the six-paragraph flowchart (background and running example, limitations, goal, challenges, solution overview, contributions); RQ-driven empirical studies follow the outsider-question route to research-question blocks. Weaves verified citations; gives an outline only on explicit request. Use when the user asks to draft, outline, or restructure an Introduction.

name: sv-write-polish
description: Polishes existing academic prose while preserving the author's meaning: grammar and flow repair, idiomatic wording, section conventions, tone calibration against evidence strength, and fair description of prior work. Light touch by default, one pass only, and every edit that could change scientific meaning is flagged. Use when the user asks to polish a draft, fix awkward wording, smooth a paragraph, or check whether a claim is too strong.

name: sv-write-section
description: Drafts publishable paper prose from the author's own materials, from one paragraph to a full manuscript, across STEM and non-STEM fields. Complements typed-primitive skills: they produce the judgement, this governs what the judgement is allowed to do.

name: szl-kernel-comparison
description: Compares a candidate numerical implementation against a reference on identical inputs: shape agreement, finite values, elementwise tolerance, and a median speedup only when both timings were taken under declared identical conditions. Use when the user claims a faster or GPU-accelerated kernel, a vectorized rewrite, a new solver or a compiled replacement 'gives the same results', or when reviewing a speedup table. Not a profiler, and it does not measure energy.

name: szl-math-claim-check
description: Checks a mathematical claim two ways: numerically, by testing declared cases under fixed tolerances and recording counterexamples; and structurally, by auditing a theorem-to-code claim's bindings (exact proposition, domain, assumptions, checker log, custom axioms) without trusting a PROVEN label. Use when a formula, inequality, conservation law or 'we proved that' statement is offered as evidence, when a Lean or Coq result is cited for a runtime, or when a derivation looks too convenient. Not a theorem prover and not a CAS.

name: szl-measurement-harmonizer
description: Align two to four bounded CSV measurement exports by explicitly declared specimen IDs and affine unit conversions. Hashes each selected file, rejects ambiguous or incomplete mappings, and emits normalized row-level evidence. Use before comparing laboratories, instruments, or studies that name the same specimens differently or report Celsius and Kelvin, or other declared linear units. Offline and standard-library only; does not infer specimen identity, verify a conversion's scientific authority, propagate uncertainty, or judge whether measurements agree.

name: szl-model-evaluation
description: Scores binary predictions (Brier, log loss, ECE, MCE, AUROC, accuracy, reliability bins, per-cohort) or saved categorical outputs joined to retained targets, and audits a multi-run evaluation plan so failed, timed-out, invalid and missing attempts stay in the denominator. Use when the user reports held-out model quality, asks whether a classifier is calibrated, or when a 'best of N runs' number needs its full attempt ledger. Not for regression, survival or multiclass metrics, and it does not run inference.

name: szl-multiplicity-audit
description: Audit a complete, predeclared family of hypothesis tests against a byte-bound results ledger. Compute Holm familywise or Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery adjusted p-values only when every planned result is present, no undeclared result or extra analysis attempt appears, and the plan digest matches. Use before citing significance across multiple outcomes, model comparisons, screens or subgroups. Offline; no credentials or outside services.

name: szl-negative-control-audit
description: Audits a registry of computational negative controls against a declared mechanism graph and the supplied outcome bytes: flags controls with a directed path from intervention to readout (not a null), controls that do not share the nuisance they are meant to absorb, post hoc tolerance changes, contamination, failed expected nulls and missing registered controls. Use when a study claims an effect is specific, when designing or reviewing scrambled, sham, shuffled-label or dummy-exposure controls, or when a reviewer asks what the controls rule out. Not a wet-lab protocol designer.

name: szl-osf-registration-witness
description: Checks a public OSF registration, its attached plan bytes and DataCite DOI with bounded keyless reads. Use when a frozen analysis plan is claimed to have an OSF public registration and a reviewer needs exact file-hash and DOI evidence. This pilot does not prove that registration preceded access to outcomes or that the science is valid.

name: szl-outcome-preservation
description: Audit an optimization's complete predeclared case cohort for numerical agreement, scientific metric drift and downstream decision changes in exact, fast or big mode. Withhold speed and memory ratios when any case is missing, fails, silently falls back or changes an outcome. Use after model or kernel optimization, precision changes or implementation replacement, especially when small tensor errors can change a scientific conclusion. Offline, bounded, standard library only; no credentials.

name: szl-paired-science
description: Qualifies a paired before/after or A/B comparison offline: binds the predictions to separately frozen inputs, targets, corpus, scorer and training-only normalization by byte digest, checks every case is complete and unsubstituted, recomputes MAE/MSE, requires an identity negative control, and applies the declared sign-flip procedure with a minimum effect. Use when a candidate model, assay protocol or pipeline change is claimed to beat a baseline on the same cases, or when a reviewer asks whether the comparison was paired and preregistered. Not a general statistics package.

name: szl-paper-evidence-audit
description: Audits claims taken from scientific PDF tables and figures against a pinned local PDF and Docling JSON, retaining page and bounding-box locators and requiring visual review. Use when a paper has old scans, complex tables, figure values, or an extracted number that must be checked before citation.

name: szl-paper-rescue-benchmark
description: Compares source-linked table-cell and figure-caption records from old scientific PDFs with a separate adjudicated reference, counting abstentions and rejecting malformed locators. Use for a rights-cleared, local PDF extraction pilot before claiming evidence quality.

name: szl-quantization-check
description: Compares a quantized, ported or distilled model's outputs with the reference model's on the same inputs, row by row: cosine similarity, KL divergence between softmaxed logits at a declared temperature, top-1 agreement, worst rows named, and WITHIN_TOLERANCE / DEGRADED / INCOMPARABLE against the tolerances you declare. Works from exported logits or embeddings; no framework needed. Use when a lab runs a local GGUF or int8 model, swaps ONNX for PyTorch, distils a classifier, or asks 'is the 4-bit version still the same model'. Not a measure of accuracy against ground truth.

name: szl-range-propagation

Use for interval bounds through sums, differences, products, or ratios. Not for probability intervals or statistical uncertainty.

name: szl-rare-disease-evidence-map
description: Build an offline, source-hash-bound evidence map from synthetic HPO-shaped disease annotations and synthetic ClinVar-shaped SCV/RCV/VCV records. name: szl-release-continuity
description: Trace supplied immutable release observations across GitHub, PyPI, Hugging Face models, datasets and Spaces, and a runtime. Use when a green CI run, published wheel, Hub listing or running Space is being treated as an end-to-end release. Offline, bounded, standard library only; no credentials.

name: szl-repo-pin
description: Records one SHA-256 pin over every Git repository an analysis depends on: HEAD commit, clean or dirty tree, exact tag, configured origin, for each declared repository, and a composite digest that exists only when every tree is clean; later re-reads them and reports MATCH / DRIFT / DIRTY / MISSING per repository. Use when an analysis spans several repositories (analysis code, data preparation, a vendored utility library), when a capsule or session receipt needs to name the code versions, or when a collaborator asks 'which commits did you actually run'. name: szl-reporting-guideline-audit
description: Map a manuscript onto the frozen PRISMA 2020, CONSORT 2025, or STROBE 2007 checklist and show every omitted item. Use before calling a paper complete against one of those guidelines. A locator is not visual confirmation, and the report does not judge reporting compliance.

name: szl-reproducibility-capsule
description: Creates an exact-byte manifest (path, size, SHA-256) for the explicitly selected files of an experiment, verifies them later as changed / missing / unsafe, and validates a bounded replay declaration (inputs, source, environment, plan, outputs) without executing anything. Use when handing an analysis to a collaborator, archiving a result, preparing a replication or when the user asks 'did anything change since the run'. Not a container, not a signature, and it does not reproduce the experiment.

name: szl-research-anatomy
description: Maintains a project's claim-and-evidence ledger as a dependency graph: datasets, code, runs, claims and proofs with supporting, contradicting and qualifying evidence links, observation dates, expiry, source revisions and corrections, then reports which conclusions need rechecking when any input changes. Use for persistent project memory across sessions, when a source is retracted or updated, when two findings conflict, or when the user asks 'what depends on this'. Not a literature monitor and not a truth oracle.

name: szl-research-change-impact
description: Compares two retained research dependency snapshots and supplied artifact readbacks, preserving removed nodes and edges when tracing impact. Produces a deterministic recheck order and witness paths; does not execute experiments or judge scientific truth.

name: szl-result-fragility
description: Computes the fragility index of a two-arm binary result: Fisher's exact p on the 2x2 table, the smallest number of participants whose outcome would have to change for significance to disappear, the fragility quotient, and a FRAGILE / ROBUST judgment against the number lost to follow-up; for non-significant results, the reverse fragility index. Exact arithmetic, stdlib only. Use when a trial or A/B result 'reached significance' on a handful of events, when a reviewer asks how fragile a finding is, when comparing a result with its dropout count, or when the user says 'how many patients away fro…

description: Safe, local-only security assessment of the Real World App through an OWASP Top 10 lens: authentication and session cookie, authorization/IDOR on transactions, bank accounts, users, notifications and comments, mass assignment, input validation, security headers and CORS, GraphQL exposure, hard-coded secrets and dependency audit. Only targets localhost:3000/3001, no DoS or brute force. Use when the student asks 'is this API secure?', 'can user A see user B's bank accounts?', or 'run a security check on my change'.

name: tap-setup
description: Choose a TAP merchant integration profile and establish explicit trust configuration.

name: tap-setup
description: 为"已登录/需认证"的网站自适应地准备 Tap——先诊断、只补缺失的一环、过人类信任闸门，再验证。公开页面/ 开放 API 无需此步（MCP 连上即可用）。触发场景：用户想在需要登录的网站（银行/后台/内部系统/社交）用 Tap；用户说"配置 tap""连接 tap""tap 连不上"；或在已登录站点上运行报错 peer/bridge 不可达。本技能 通过 `tap embed --verify` 自适应地驱动设置，而非盲目跑安装器。

name: tap-setup
description: Install everything TAP26 needs, idempotently: checks Node against .nvmrc and Yarn 1, installs root app dependencies without the Cypress binary, installs the Playwright framework and Chromium, optionally seeds the database, then verifies with the doctor. Use on first checkout, after a git pull that changed package files, or when the doctor reports missing dependencies or browsers.

name: tap-skill-authoring
description: Create AgentSkills-compliant SKILL.md packs: frontmatter, auto-activation rules, domains, bundled resources, lint gates. Use when editing a SKILL.md.

name: tap-start
description: Welcome and onboarding for TAP26-Junior. Runs the environment doctor, explains in ten lines how agents, skills, memory and hooks fit together, shows the five most useful commands and recommends the next lab. Use when a student opens the repo for the first time, says 'where do I start', 'what is TAP26' or 'help me get going'.
allowed_tools: Bash(git status *), Bash(head *), Bash(ls *), Bash(node tap26/scripts/*)

name: tap-status
description: One-screen TAP26 dashboard for the Real World App: environment and app health (doctor --quick), memory digest highlights, active work, recent app changes from the change ledger, uncommitted git changes, open questions and the last Playwright test results, with a suggested next action. Read-only. Use when the student asks 'status', 'where are we', 'what's going on', 'is everything running', or at the start/end of a session.

name: tap-step
description: Performs a tap dance shuffle, tapping the toes and heels with quick light foot articulations and loose arms. Use when the command mentions tap dance, tap step, shuffle ball change, or tap your feet.

name: tap-swagger
description: Work with the RWA API contract through the contract-guardian: regenerate tap26/openapi/openapi.json from openapi.yaml, lint it with Redocly, check spec-to-code drift against the Express routes, serve Swagger UI on http://localhost:3100 and explain how to use Try it out with the session cookie. Use when a student says 'open swagger', 'is the spec up to date', 'regenerate the openapi json', 'check drift' or after an API change.
allowed_tools: Bash(ls *), Bash(git status *), Bash(node tap26/scripts/*), Bash(npx --yes js-yaml *), Bash(npx --yes @redocly/cli@1 lint *)

name: tap-sync-tests
description: Bring the Playwright tests back in sync with recent app changes: runs tap26/scripts/impact.mjs on the git diff (or --since <ref>) plus the change ledger, gets a test impact report from test-impact-analyst, has api-automation / ui-automation update the affected tests, runs them twice and reports. Use after someone changed backend/ or src/ by hand, after a git pull, or when a student asks 'which tests do I need to update?'.

name: tap-tapping
description: Decode Tap tapcodes (which fingers tapped), map finger combinations to app actions or keyboard shortcuts, and give haptic feedback. Use for tapping, finger combos, chords, tap-to-action, shortcuts, input modes, or the TAPPING vision model.

name: tap-tapping
description: Decode Tap tapcodes (which fingers tapped), map finger combinations to in-page actions, and give haptic feedback. Use for tapping, finger combos, chords, tap-to-action, shortcuts, InputModeController, or the TAPPING vision model.

name: tap-test-cases
description: Design manual test cases for a Real World App feature in one of three formats: a classic steps table (ID, preconditions, data, steps, expected), Gherkin scenarios with examples, or a time-boxed exploratory charter with session notes. Applies equivalence partitioning, boundary values, state transitions and decision tables, and flags automation candidates. Use when the student says 'write test cases for sign-up', 'give me Gherkin for creating a payment', or 'an exploratory charter for notifications'.

name: tap-test-plan
description: Write a risk-based test plan for a feature, change, story or the current git diff of the Real World App: scope in/out, likelihood x impact risk matrix, approach per test level (Vitest unit, Playwright API/UI/e2e, manual, a11y/security/perf), test data, entry/exit criteria and traceability to existing specs. Use when the student asks 'how should we test X', 'write a test plan for the bank-account note field', or before a release or a larger change.

name: tap-testcontainers
description: ALWAYS consult this skill when the user works with Testcontainers, Docker containers for tests, tap before/after hooks for container lifecycle, or test environment setup with test-env.json and localtest.ts. This skill contains the exact architecture for container-based test infrastructure (Ryuk reaper, before.js executors, container runners, teardown.js, localtest.ts environment loader) that Claude cannot reconstruct correctly without consulting. Without this skill, Claude will produce incorrect container lifecycle management, miss reaper label configuration, and break inter-process environme…

name: tap-to-judge
description: Build a tappable judging board when the user needs to review a list of candidates — golden-set curation, labelling, false-positive sampling, draft review, accept/reject on agent output. The user taps through it on any device and the verdicts come back as structured data. Triggers — "let me review these", "I want to check these myself", "make me a review screen", "let me pick", "label these", "judgement board". Offer it unprompted whenever a review would take more than about 10 items.

name: tap-to-pay-on-iphone
description: Comprehensive reference for Apple's Tap to Pay on iPhone — the ProximityReader framework, PSP integration, entitlement workflow, marketing guidelines, and regional availability. Use this skill whenever the user asks about implementing contactless payments on iPhone, the ProximityReader API, Tap to Pay entitlements, NFC payment acceptance, loyalty card reading via NFC, payment service provider (PSP) selection for Tap to Pay, or merchant-facing payment app development. Also trigger when the user mentions "Tap to Pay", "TTP", "softPOS", "iPhone as terminal", "contactless payment acceptance", or…

name: tap-triggers
description: 声明一个已保存的 tap"何时"无人值守运行——~/.tap/triggers/ 下的 trigger.json 声明会被确定性地编译成 launchd plist（dev.taprun.trigger.* 命名空间），每次触发零 token。前台受限计划（trusted:true）在声明时 即被拒绝。适用于用户想"每天跑这个 tap""定时检查""排个日程""放到 launchd"。注意：当前仅 macOS + launchd；Windows 端为同一声明格式下的 systemd 等价物（待实现）。

name: tap-viet
description: Tập viết cùng AI: người viết tự nghĩ, tự viết; AI đặt câu hỏi, phản biện, soi xét và khai vấn, không soạn bản thay. Dành cho người viết có uy tín nghề nghiệp (nhà giáo dục, nhà tham vấn, nhà khai vấn, giảng viên, chuyên gia) muốn văn mình thật là của mình và muốn viết giỏi lên. Bốn cửa: cùng nghĩ (ý chưa thành bài, luận đề, hạt giống, chất liệu), định hình (thể loại, thể thức, mức dùng AI, cường độ soi), soi bản tự viết (tám phẩm chất, FACTUAL, ACCORD-ACCEPT, linh hoạt theo chất lượng mong muốn và thời gian), nhìn lại sau bài. Dùng khi người dùng nói "tập viết", "nghĩ cùng tôi", "tôi đang có…

name: tap-vision-models
description: Switch the TapXR / TapBand vision model between TAPPING and AIR_GESTURE, set the op mode, and decode UnifiedAirGestures (swipes, pinches, holds, fist). Use for air gestures, pinch, swipe, fist, model switching, or AirGestures on Tap Strap.

name: tap-vision-models
description: Switch the TapSDKWeb2 vision model between TAPPING and AIR_GESTURE, set the op mode, and decode UnifiedAirGestures (swipes, pinches, holds, fist). Use for air gestures, pinch, swipe, fist, model switching, or AirGestures on TapSDKWeb.

name: tap-watch
description: Taps the wrist pointedly to signal hurry up or check the time. Use when the command mentions tap your watch, hurry up, we are late, check the time, or point at your wrist.

name: tap-water-philosophy
description: Evaluate products, services, and pricing decisions against the standard of abundance and accessibility. The mission of a manufacturer is to produce goods so plentifully and affordably that they bec...

name: tap-web
description: Access websites, search the web, and extract clean content using the `tap` CLI. Supports structured site scripts, readable page extraction, and browser automation for tabs, screenshots, forms, cookies, JavaScript evaluation, and network capture. Use for web lookup, page reading, content extraction, browser interaction, authenticated sessions, request interception, or CDP-connected desktop apps.

name: tapa-chrisu
description: Sistema visual del disco de Chrisu, ambientado en un campo de lavandas. Usar esta skill cuando se pida generar la tapa de disco de Chrisu o los frames iniciales/finales de video de Chrisu.

name: tapa-de-ux
description: Revisão de UX de apps e telas — hierarquia, tipografia, acessibilidade, cor, botões, formulários, estados, textos e navegação. Use ao revisar, criar ou corrigir uma interface.

name: tapa-de-ux-en
description: UX review for apps and screens — hierarchy, typography, accessibility, color, buttons, forms, states, UX writing and navigation. Use when reviewing, building or fixing an interface.

name: tapcanvas-api
description: 统一的 TapCanvas API skill。凡是要通过 TapCanvas 项目的 `/public/*` 接口、受保护的 `/projects` 接口、或 `/agents/llm/*` 推理接口（含视频理解 videoUnderstand）完成 chat、draw、vision、video、tasks/result、flows 读写、视频内容分析时，都必须使用这个 skill。agents bridge 通过已注入的 TapCanvas 远程工具面执行，终端环境通过同目录脚本执行；两者共用同一后端契约与显式失败策略。

name: tapcanvas-character-card
description: TapCanvas 规范化角色卡与群演视觉选角参考的唯一生成与改造 skill。凡是创建、补全、重建、批量生成或去同质化 `character-card/v3` / `identity-board/v3` 角色卡、角色身份锚、角色圣经视觉卡、角色状态版本卡，或其他 skill 在分镜/视频前发现缺少 canonical 角色视觉锚时，都必须使用本 skill；负责把故事事实编译为有行为来源、有关系压力、有独立视觉 DNA 的角色资产，并通过结构化 ID绑定到真实画布。视频原片关键帧的直接提取、登记和复用不属于本 skill，应由 `tapcanvas-parse-video` 处理，除非用户明确要求将其进一步规范化为角色卡。需要群演全身群像、按镜头用途分配演员资产投入或由群体参考升级单人身份卡时，也使用本 skill；群体参考使用 ensemble，不冒充单人身份锚。角色出场选择与剧情改编不由本 skill 决定；场景卡与场景灯光只用 tapcanvas-scene-card，可复用道具卡只用 tapcanvas-prop-card，群像关系图和单镜表演提示词也不使用本 skill。

name: tapcanvas-collage-local
description: Use local Python Pillow to compose storyboard/role-card collages with per-cell role-name labels. No model call needed.

name: tapcanvas-continuity
description: 处理章节分镜续写、storyboardChunks、tailFrameUrl 与连续性审查，确保续写边界与尾帧承接可追溯。

name: tapcanvas-demo-patterns
description: 使用已提炼的视觉连续性方法论：先锁资产、角色、场景与镜头语义，再做扩镜与视频。

name: tapcanvas-design-to-web
description: 基于用户提供的设计稿图片还原真实网页。该 skill 可用于任意前端项目，但强依赖本地已启动且已授权的 TapCanvas vision 工作流；默认使用 `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` 做视觉取证，支持外部传入 vision prompt，且不可静默降级。

name: tapcanvas-dialogue-drama
description: TapCanvas 文戏与对白方法扩展。按当前人物交流、信息差和关系变化自主选择表演、话轮、调度、取景与声音；完整保留冻结发声，结构与引用服从本轮 schema。可按需加载，不强制逐句动作、镜头切换、旁白比例或复盘流程。

name: tapcanvas-dramatic-adapter
description: 根据用户创作简报与真实素材原创整片，或将小说章节改编为可拍的统一 BeatSheet 合同。一键成片、素材演示、讲解与表演设计、小说转视频、章节改编、指定总时长创作或 BeatSheet 提交前审读时使用；先按完整用户目标确定原创与来源守恒范围，再组织全片表达、动作、声音和分段接力。只负责 writer fan-out 前的整片语义创作，不写最终视频 prompt、不生成资产。

name: tapcanvas-generate-scene-references
description: TapCanvas 章节场景与人物参考资产的轻量编排 Skill。仅用于 `generate_scene_references` intent：读取章节和真实画布，识别本章需要稳定视觉身份的场景、人物与群体，差量调用 tapcanvas-scene-card / tapcanvas-character-card 编译完整节点，再通过允许的工具落画布。本 Skill 不维护任何场景 prompt、灯光模板、角色或群演模板、固定模型、URL 复用或语义关键词规则。

name: tapcanvas-generate-shot-placeholders
description: TapCanvas 镜头设计板意图技能（v16 一镜到底决策）。用于章节正文 / 视频脚本 / 单镜头文本节点上的 `generate_shot_placeholders` intent：编剧定节拍、导演拆 Cut，每板 1 个 `kind=image` 节点（默认 6-7 镜、≤15s），逐板提交真实图片并保留节点与任务回执。Seedance/即梦视频脚本会自动判断采用「一镜到底」或「2s 一切镜」模式（决策见 §4.13）。所有数字与必填硬约束集中在「硬约束速查表」一节，其余章节只描述创作纪律与字段规范。

name: tapcanvas-high-energy-action
description: TapCanvas 动作导演方法：把打斗、追逐与超自然能力对决拆成一条条看得懂的动作链（出手→接触→受力→新局面），按攻防写镜头、给接触证据、安排快慢与攻守转换；宿主在动作段按演出类型预载给逐 Clip 作者，也供前置编剧设计可拍动作。不创建平行工作流或运行时质量闸门。

name: tapcanvas-high-energy-action
description: TapCanvas 高能超自然动作方法：供前置编剧设计可拍动作与持续节奏，也供 tapcanvas-video-prompt-writer 编译冻结事实的单 Clip 视觉语言；不创建平行工作流或运行时质量闸门。

name: tapcanvas-parse-video
description: Import a video share link or direct video URL into the current TapCanvas canvas as a hosted video node.

name: tapcanvas-prompt-specialists
description: 定义 image_prompt_specialist、video_prompt_specialist、pacing_reviewer 的职责边界、触发条件与最小输出契约；不强制固定调用顺序。

name: tapcanvas-prop-card
description: TapCanvas 规范化道具卡的唯一生成与改造 Skill。创建、补全、重建、批量生成或派生可复用道具、武器、法器、器物与关键物件的基态身份锚或状态版本时使用；把来源事实编译为 prop-card/v1、prop-board/v1 与 prop-function/v1，并通过真实节点/素材 ID 落到画布。一次性布景装饰、角色身份、场景空间、单镜动作与 VFX 不使用本 Skill。

name: tapcanvas-public-chat
description: 定义 TapCanvas agents chat 运行时协作原则：web 收集上下文，hono-api 注入硬约束，agents 自主决策，skills 提供方法论。此 skill 只负责协作原则，不负责直接调用 TapCanvas `/public/*` API；凡是实际发请求，统一改用 `tapcanvas-api`。

name: tapcanvas-replicate
description: 多资产复刻能力：基于 assetInputs（N 张图）执行角色或主体替换，保持版式与镜头连续性。

name: tapcanvas-scene-card
description: TapCanvas 场景卡、场景参考图、空间锚、场景状态版与灯光设计的唯一权威 Skill。用户要求创建、重建、批量生成、去同质化、补光、改光、夜景/日景转换、天气光、实景/动画场景设定，或其他 Skill 需要可复用场景视觉资产时必须使用。把故事事实、空间因果、材质生态和叙事意图编译为 scene-card/v1、可执行图片提示词与 scene-lighting/v1 物理灯光合同；禁止平行场景模板、关键词世界观路由、固定模型、固定“电影感”前缀或 Hono/Web 语义闸门。

name: tapcanvas-screenwriter
description: TapCanvas 编剧：依据用户意图与真实来源完成剧情完整、人物与因果忠实的剧本、章节改编或视频前置正文；自由选择画面、对白、心声与旁白的表达。按当前节点合同交付，连载企划才设计系列圣经，逐镜机位和真实出片交对应技能。

name: tapcanvas-source-coverage
description: TapCanvas 长材料证据覆盖与交付核验协议。分析小说全文、长章节、多文件、字幕、访谈、视频时间轴或任何需要声称“完整看过/全量覆盖”的来源时使用；也用于复核分块分析是否漏段、重叠结果是否重复、部分失败是否被误报成完成。只验证来源范围、证据锚点与覆盖状态，不用关键词或正则替 agents 判断内容语义，也不替代具体的研究、审稿、IP 筛选或导演拆解 skill。

name: tapcanvas-storyboard-expert
description: 统一的 TapCanvas 小说/剧本章节分镜专家。用户要求根据小说或剧本生成分镜、镜头脚本、人物资产后的镜头设计，或同时交付“人物资产和分镜”时使用；也覆盖漫剧创作、分镜提示词、Seedance 片段脚本、章节出镜头、剧情确认后的 story_preview 九宫格预演，以及“不改剧情、3 秒内切镜、多特写/反应镜、1 分 30 秒到 2 分钟、表格分镜”的忠实快节奏拍摄脚本。默认输出 storyboard-director/v1.2 JSON，用户明确只要表格时输出统一 13 列分镜表。

name: tapcanvas-style-pack
description: TapCanvas 项目视觉方向创作、风格包提取与应用技能。用户未指定影调时，根据故事和真实项目事实原创视觉方向；已有真实参考图、风格包、Style Bible 或第一方影调规范时，提取、整理、保存、更新、审查或应用其视觉风格 DNA；区分可迁移的色彩、光线、构图、镜头、材质、运动语法与不可复用的具体内容，并按授权落到真实画布节点或书级 Style Bible。

name: tapcanvas-video-authoring-stages
description: 一键成片的分步创作合同。仅在已保存 Workflow IR 的章节编排、共享资产提取、逐 Clip 设计节点中使用；按本节点 artifact 类型交付，禁止把其它阶段内容重新塞回章节稿。

name: tapcanvas-video-prompt-governance
description: 治理 TapCanvas 视频提示词权威合同及其 writer、reviewer、领域 Skill 与知识输入的一致性。新增或更新视频提示词 Skill、导演方法、Seedance 方法、提示词知识卡、审核标准、结构字段或 provider 规则时必须使用；把新知识拆成合同升级、领域扩展、动态供应商事实或非阻塞经验，生成可审查 diff、reviewer 映射、eval 方案并运行结构一致性审计。

name: tapcanvas-video-prompt-writer
description: TapCanvas 单段视频提示词作者。把本轮冻结的剧情、完整发声和真实资产表达为可执行声画；用户只要提示词时交付文本，Workflow 按当前 artifact schema 交付生产包。镜头、表演、旁白、剪辑和声音方法由作者结合当前剧情自主选择，不生成资产或启动另一条工作流。

name: tapcanvas-video-prompting
description: 处理关键帧转视频、短视频规划、节奏控制与拆段判断；输出最小可执行的视频提示词结果，不把 SOP 固化进后端 prompt。

name: tapcanvas-video-reviewer
description: TapCanvas 视频提示词的可选评审。用户或当前 Agent 明确选择诊断时，依据实际来源、用户目标和提示词指出具体问题；不作为视频作者默认前置、不固定打分或逐条流程，不提交媒体或拦截已有资产。

name: tapcanvas-video-workflow
description: TapCanvas 一键成片、首视频验证与完整视频生产唯一主路径。凡终态交付是真实视频、从小说章节一键成片、只生成第一条视频、完整成片、拆段验证、恢复或中断视频工作流，都必须使用本 skill，并启动当前用户已装配的 Workflow IR；禁止由根代理直接调用裸视频生成、普通工作流或已退役黑盒入口建立平行生产链。

name: tapcanvas-visual-focus
